sections.accountHint: Who the client is and how points are priced.
sections.contractHint: Term, invoice day and where invoices go.
sections.technicalHint: The client's telephony and web servers.
sections.contactsHint: One person per area. All optional.

fields.name: Name
fields.ratePerPointHint: Charged for every point over the free allowance
fields.invoiceGenerationDayHint: Day of month (1-28) the monthly draft is created
fields.billingEmailsHint: Invoices are sent to every address. Up to {{max}}.
fields.phoneNumbersHint: Inbound numbers routed to the client. Up to {{max}}.
fields.notesPlaceholder: Anything the team should know about this client

form.unsaved: Fix the highlighted fields and try again.

detail.notFoundDescription: It may have been removed, or the link is wrong.

expiry.expired: The contract ended on {{date}} ({{count}} days ago). Renew it or disable the partner.
expiry.expiring: The contract ends on {{date}}, in {{count}} days.

dialogs.enableDescription: Portal admins can sign in again and the partner is included in monthly invoicing.
dialogs.disableDescription: Every portal admin of this partner is signed out at once and cannot sign in until you enable it again.
dialogs.deleteDescription: The partner is deactivated and marked deleted. Its invoices, tasks and documents are kept.

overview.noSeats: No seats in the pool yet.

documents.title: Documents
documents.description: Contracts and technical documents, versioned. The newest version is current.
documents.deleteDescription: All {{count}} versions are removed. This cannot be undone.
documents.uploadDescription: The file stays in your browser; only its name, size and type are recorded.
documents.fileHint: PDF, image, text or Word, up to 25 MB
documents.noPreview: This file type cannot be previewed in the browser. Download it to open.

rates.newRateHint: Applies from the chosen date. The current row closes the day before.

keys.title: Generate an API key
keys.description: Keys let the client's telephony system report its user count to the machine API.
keys.label: Label
keys.revealDescription: This is the only time the secret is shown. Store it in the client's system; it cannot be recovered.
keys.emptyDescription: Generate one above when the client is ready to sync.

admins.title: Portal admins
admins.description: People at the client who sign in to the partner portal.
admins.createDescription: Share the username and temporary password with the client securely.
admins.usernameHint: Lowercase letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore
admins.deactivateDescription: They are signed out of the portal at once and cannot sign in until reactivated.
admins.reactivateDescription: They can sign in to the portal again with their existing password.
admins.emptyDescription: Create one so the client can submit tasks and see invoices.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
